schema_notes.artifact_names: Each case directory contains uiflow2-ui-test.bin, after.ppm, serial.log and optional nonempty/required serial1.log; missing FAIL artifacts are null.
schema_notes.oracle_normalisation: checks maps original unique check name to original status; all checks share case evidence_sources except explicit check_evidence_overrides; validation is complete, with sensitive data redacted. Additional check fields are retained when present.
schema_notes.original_objects: Full check objects, reason/test descriptions, reference_layout and exact commands remain in round.path/summary.json bound by round.summary_sha256. No oracle was rerun or reclassified.
schema_notes.guest_inventory: Concatenate path_prefix+files key; the integer value indexes sha256_table. This preserves every original source filename and SHA.
schema_notes.runtime_assignment: independent_c6.case_ids use that existing complete 13-file runtime; all remaining cases use native_v7_xtensa.

remaining_boundaries: This full matrix is separate from browser/WASM and StackChan Arduino deep-test evidence; it does not establish same-guest RESET or physical servo equivalence.
No hardware, RF, electrical, acoustic, optical or mechanical measurement claim.
SCS speed-only/PWM dynamics, speed feedback and EEPROM LOCK/ID/reset/baud semantics remain partial.
The native build has SLIRP disabled; this run does not validate complete networking.
Original per-case deterministic settings remain unchanged; native clock is not a browser/WASM speed divisor.
